metaDescription: Kevin's Nov 20 Friday stream covers the NSA outage, 11 NSA and Cyber Command suicides near Fort Meade, the n0n extortion group, and Trump's crypto remarks.
summary: This Friday livestream is Kevin's weekly discussion of the NSA network outage, a reported cluster of NSA and US Cyber Command suicides, and the n0n extortion group. Kevin cites Bloomberg's report of at least 11 deaths in 12 months, most near Fort Meade, and says the story deserves more scrutiny. He also summarizes research on n0n's bank data theft, questions the "rogue agent" narrative, and discusses Whitney Webb's CBDC warning, Trump's remarks on crypto, and Cambridge Dictionary naming "human" word of the year. He also promotes the Discord book club reading The Nerd Reich and recommends Netflix's The Altruists.
